Clinical Treatment Summary
The patient presented for evaluation of a concussion sustained when another vehicle sideswiped their car during a lane change.
The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms, and the head and neck complaints are plausible for a collision
of this type. Over four visits, care followed a typical course of concussion management, including symptom monitoring,
cognitive and vestibular rest guidance, and graded return-to-activity instructions. Symptoms gradually improved and treatment
tapered accordingly. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm the injury. The patient also reported a minor strain in the
same region several years ago, which resolved completely without residual limitation. Billing records showing two similar
chrages entered on the same day are currently under review by the administrative team. Clinical follow-up is planned as needed.

Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
